identity.fantasy: A dual-wield martial engraver who brands a priority target, detonates marks with Runeblade, and lets fast elemental weapon procs splash through the pack.
identity.one_line: A martial engraver using Runic Brand, Runeblade, elemental weapon procs, Fists of Power, Zenith, and leyline burst. The player maintains brands and engraving states while attacking at a fast pace, then amplifies the package with Runic Tempest or Ley Power.

mechanics.core_loop: Select Water tattoos for sustainable mana, apply Runic Brand marks to the priority target, pop them with Runeblade, use Primordial Blast to reset Runeblade charges, and weave Fist of the Ancients only when brands and blast are unavailable while Zenith and weapon engravings amplify the cycle.

modes.name: Elemental Mastery
modes.structural_description: Damage dealt by Runic Brand now has a 33% chance to transform your Primordial Blast into a random unique elemental version of itself.

modes.name: Earth, Wind, and Fire
modes.structural_description: Striking at least 5 enemies with Runic Explosion now unleashes Wild Steam.Wild Steam (Transform)Stomp the ground in a 5 yd radius around you and release steam, dealing 128 + 25% AP Frostfire Damage to nearby enemies.

modes.name: Steam Conjurer
modes.structural_description: Damage dealt by Weapon Engraving: Earth now has a 5% chance to cast Wild Steam. Can only occur once every 3 sec.Wild Steam (Transform)Stomp the ground in a 5 yd radius around you and release steam, dealing 128 + 25% AP Frostfire Damage to nearby enemies.

mechanics.single_target: Prioritize Primordial Blast, keep Runic Brand marks active, detonate them through Runeblade filler, and use Frost plus Fire or double Fire engravings with the single-target talent swap.
mechanics.aoe: Use Earth plus Fire engravings and funnel into one important target while mark explosions, Wild Steams, and weapon procs passively damage the pack.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: The loop can move with the target, but its funnel design rewards keeping the correct priority enemy selected rather than spreading attention evenly.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Guarding Rune, Granite Shield, wards, tattoo utility, and a strong interrupt give the fast melee build meaningful defensive options.
mechanics.group_utility: Magic Etchings, Symbols of Power, a short-cast interrupt, and optional Guarding Rune can contribute group damage and defense.

failure_modes.text: Branding the wrong enemy, failing to detonate marks before a reset, or using slow weapons reduces both priority damage and the passive cleave built around it.

Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: the loop can move with the target, but its funnel design rewards keeping the correct priority enemy selected rather than spreading attention evenly.

Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: guarding rune, granite shield, wards, tattoo utility, and a strong interrupt give the fast melee build meaningful defensive options.

claims.text: The July Engravement guide documents Earth plus Fire engravings for AoE and Frost plus Fire or double Fire for single target. It recommends very fast weapons, Water tattoos until mana supports Fire swapping, priority-target funneling through Runic Brand and Runeblade detonations, Primordial Blast resets, and Fist of the Ancients only during gaps. Single-target and AoE versions differ by a few talents.
claims.notes: The author explicitly says the guide is provisional rather than expert-validated.

claims.text: Recent Runemaster discussion describes the melee variants as input-heavy and capable of strong damage, but reports survivability pressure and incomplete community understanding.
claims.notes: Community label Engravement maps to current dataset name Runic.

claims.text: The July DPS compilation reports Engravement at 3,702, and the August Mythic inventory lists 71 Runic or Engravement records.
claims.notes: Runic is the dataset label; Engravement is the community label. Sources are unnormalized.

claims.text: Runic's main execution cost is funnel discipline: selecting the right durable target and converting brands and resets there determines both priority damage and the passive AoE surrounding it.
claims.notes: Playstyle classification from the documented funnel loop.
